newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev firms to 1,580-1,590 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev firms to 1,580-1,590 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev firmed to 1,580-1,590 per dollar in light interbank volume from opening near 1,610 due to higher dollar supply, traders said.
"The lev rose 20-30 per dollar from early trade because foreign currency demand is very low. But supply is running high and is coming mainly from clients," a bank dealer said.
The central bank was seen buying relatively small dollar volumes at market levels, absorbing the higher supply and containing the lev rise, dealers said.
Central bank officials were not available for comment. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569; 981 4145
